name: budget-router
description: Stop burning your weekly Claude limit by accident. Picks the model and effort for every prompt, turns your weekly limit into a daily budget with a wrap-up warning, and learns which cheaper setting is enough for your work. Shows today's budget in the status bar. Local only: sends nothing, runs no programs, reads no files, adds nothing to your prompts, never blocks a prompt, a tool call or a subagent.

tierTrivial.title: Trivial tier
tierTrivial.description: model:effort for chit-chat, quick facts, one obvious command

tierLight.title: Light tier
tierLight.description: model:effort for small, fully specified edits and lookups

tierStandard.title: Standard tier
tierStandard.description: model:effort for normal coding, debugging, config work

tierDeep.title: Deep tier
tierDeep.description: model:effort for design, hard bugs, refactors, security, research

tierMax.title: Max tier
tierMax.description: model:effort when the prompt says think hard / ultrathink

pin.title: Pin the route
pin.description: auto (default) routes every prompt; a tier (trivial, light, standard, deep, max) or a model with an optional effort (haiku, sonnet:low, opus:high) fixes it. Usage caps still apply.

wrapUpPercent.title: Wrap-up notice at
wrapUpPercent.description: Percent of today's budget at which one heads-up is given before the caps tighten (0 switches it off)

warnPercent.title: First cap at (% of daily budget)
warnPercent.description: At this share of today's budget the cap below applies and an alert shows

criticalPercent.title: Second cap at (% of daily budget)
criticalPercent.description: At this share of today's budget the stricter cap applies

includeFiveHour.title: Also cap on the 5-hour window
includeFiveHour.description: Apply the same caps when the 5-hour rate-limit window passes the thresholds (never locks on it)

unrealRules.title: Unreal build rules
unrealRules.description: Prompts about UBT, linker, cook or packaging errors never run on the trivial or light tier

escalateOnTrouble.title: Escalate when a turn goes badly
escalateOnTrouble.description: Raise effort after 3 failed tool calls in one turn, and the model one step after 6

paceControl.title: Pace control
paceControl.description: Route one or two cost steps cheaper while today's use runs ahead of an even spread over 08:00-24:00

idleGuard.title: Idle cache guard
idleGuard.description: warn (a notice when a pause of over 55 minutes means a context of 60k+ tokens is re-written from scratch) or off. Never holds a prompt

nudgeContext.title: Large-context notice
nudgeContext.description: Notice each time the context grows past a multiple of this many tokens (0 turns it off)

learnMode.title: Learner mode
learnMode.description: live (the learner may move the model and effort one step on evidence), shadow (it learns but never changes the route) or off

tips.title: Token-saving tips
tips.description: Show a short tip when the situation calls for it (a long paste, a long turn, repeated failures, a capped day). Shown to you only, at most one every 10 minutes, each once per session. Details in CHEATSHEET.md
